sections.title: Sec 1: Prerequisite: The Concept of Slope
animations: Animation step 1: Fade in a straight line from #000000 to #FFFFFF with two points marked in #FFD700.
Animation step 2: Draw a right triangle under the line with base #4169E1 and height #DC143C, labeling 'run' and 'rise'.
Animation step 3: Display text 'Slope = Δy/Δx' in #FFFFFF near the triangle, then fade out the triangle.

sections.title: Sec 2: The Problem: Changing Steepness on a Curve
lecture_lines: What is slope at one point?
animations: Animation step 1: Draw the parabola y=x² in #FFFFFF, highlighting the vertex at (0,0).
Animation step 2: Place a glowing dot #FFD700 at (1,1) on the curve.
Animation step 3: Flash the dot and display text 'Slope at x=1?' in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Sec 3: Visualizing the Tangent Line
animations: Animation step 1: Draw a red secant line #FF0000 connecting (1,1) and (1.1,1.21) on y=x².
Animation step 2: Animate the point (1.1,1.21) sliding along the curve toward (1,1).
Animation step 3: As the point approaches, the red line rotates and changes color to green #00FF00.
Animation step 4: The green line stabilizes as the tangent at (1,1), labeled 'Tangent'.
Animation step 5: Fade out the moving point, leaving only the green tangent line and the point (1,1).

sections.title: Sec 4: Derivative as the Slope of the Tangent
animations: Animation step 1: Display formula 'f'(x) = 2x' in #FFFFFF near the tangent line.
Animation step 2: Draw a right triangle under the tangent line at (1,1) with run 1 (#4169E1) and rise 2 (#DC143C).
Animation step 3: Label the slope '2' in #FFD700 at the midpoint of the tangent line.

sections.title: Sec 5: Dynamic Application: The Moving Point
animations: Animation step 1: A glowing dot #FFD700 moves from x=-2 to x=2 along y=x².
Animation step 2: A green tangent line #00FF00 sticks to the dot, rotating as the dot moves.
Animation step 3: A digital display next to the dot shows the slope value changing from -4 to 4 in #FFFFFF.
